hints.title: Exact Precedence Value
hints.text: Compute the standard correct mathematical answer by evaluating all multiplications before additions.

hints.title: Interval Dynamic Programming for Arbitrary Bracketings
hints.text: Any evaluation order corresponds to some parenthesization. Use interval dynamic programming over subexpressions dp[i][j].

hints.title: Prune Values Above One Thousand
hints.text: Because student answers never exceed one thousand, drop any intermediate arithmetic results strictly greater than one thousand.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N^3 * V^2 + A) where N is number of operands, V is intermediate value set size, and A is answer count
complexity.space: O(N^2 * V) to store intermediate arithmetic sets
complexity.notes: Pruning values above 1000 keeps intermediate sets small and prevents combinatorial explosion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursion without interval memoization generates Catalan number of operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval dynamic programming caches all feasible subexpression outcomes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute correct precedence value first and use interval DP with value cap for bracketings.
